The isotope pattern with ~14.2% at M+1 and ~1.14% at M+2 suggests the presence of carbon atoms (natural abundance of 13C is ~1.1% per carbon atom).

- C9H11NO3: 9×12 + 11×1.00783 + 14.00307 + 3×15.99491 = 108 + 11.08613 + 14.00307 + 47.98473 = 181.07393 (very close!)
